prompt: Write a single, self-contained prompt for a text-to-image model that has never heard of Chinese memes, so that it draws a giraffe version of the "大笑奶龙" (Laughing Nailong / 奶蛙) meme. Output only the prompt.
answer: A single centered, front-facing cartoon character illustration in a flat 2D children's-animation style: a chubby baby giraffe drawn as a round-headed mascot, head almost as large as its pear-shaped body, butter-yellow fur with soft rounded tan-brown patches, two tiny knob-like horns and small rounded ears on top, a short blunt muzzle with two dot nostrils, stubby little arms and short thick legs, a small tufted tail. Its face is locked in an enormous, hysterical belly-laugh: the mouth is stretched into an absurdly wide grin that spans nearly the entire width of the face, far wider than the muzzle should allow, hanging open to show a dark mouth cavity, a small pink tongue and a single row of blunt white upper teeth; the cheeks are shoved up into fat rounded bulges and the eyes are squeezed shut into two thin upward-curving black crescents, eyebrows raised high, head tipped slightly back and to one side as if howling with mocking, unhinged delight, tiny arms flung up. The exaggerated frog-like wideness of the smile should read as slightly uncanny and off-model, comedic rather than cute. Thick uniform dark-brown outlines, flat solid color fills, almost no shading or texture, plain pale off-white background, waist-up framing, square composition, no text, no letters, no watermark.
